name: Municipalidad Metropolitana de Lima
summary_text: Model estimate (route 3, best-knowledge delta): capital metro — the entire scene (NGOs including MHOL), anonymity of 10 million; Miraflores/Barranco visitor districts experience a normal Latin-urban climate. Its own sources sharpen the picture: the Congressional Women and Family Committee unanimously approved bills barring trans people from public toilets of the sex assigned at birth (20 Feb 2025; the plenary approved the fused text on 2 April 2025, with custody, medical, caregiving and disability exceptions), and the international airport relabeled its bathrooms to "women in their diversity / men in their diversity" after a 2023 complaint. A university observatory counted 54 LGBTQ+ killings and 170 rights violations 2020-2023, 30 of the dead trans women; in Feb 2023 a 31-year-old trans sex worker was abducted from central Lima's Chancay street by a criminal gang and shot dead. Scored relative to the national score (0.36) for Peru.

sources.title: Congreso aprueba norma que atenta contra el derecho de las personas trans a usar baños públicos - Infobae
sources.claim_summary: Infobae Peru (20 Feb 2025): the Congressional Women and Family Commission unanimously approved the committee report of bills 6506 and 8457 (presented by Montoya and Muñante) barring entry to public toilets of the sex opposite to birth sex, with exceptions for custody, medical care, accompanying an elderly person, a child under 12 or a disabled person, and banning ambiguous bathroom signage; still required plenary backing. Recounts the 2023 international-airport bathroom-signage complaint ('women in their diversity / men in their diversity') and quotes an activist calling the measure discriminatory.

sources.title: Discriminación legalizada: sobre la prohibición del Congreso a personas trans para acceder a baños públicos - IDEHPUCP
sources.claim_summary: IDEHPUCP analysis (15 April 2025), 'Legalised discrimination: on Congress's prohibition of trans people accessing public restrooms': on 2 April 2025 the plenary approved, waiving a second vote, the law strengthening the sexual integrity of children and adolescents (fused bills 6505/2023-CR and 8457/2023-CR, aimed at protecting the integrity of minors under 14), whose text openly discriminates against trans and non-binary people by restricting access to hygiene services matching their gender identity.

sources.title: Perú: aumentaron los crímenes de odio y las mujeres trans son las más afectadas - Agencia Presentes
sources.claim_summary: Agencia Presentes (22 July 2024): the TLGBI Rights Observatory of Cayetano Heredia University's annual report counted 54 LGBTQ+ killings and 170 rights violations 2020-2023 — over half the dead were trans women (30), then gay men (23), one lesbian; 2023 the deadliest year (19 killings, 12 trans women); violations peaked in 2020 (61 reports); extreme cruelty documented. Details the Feb 2023 case of trans sex worker Rubí Torres Silvano (31): abducted from central Lima's Chancay street by the 'Los Gallegos' gang, taken to Carabayllo and shot dead.
